status: Approved by the project owner 2026-11-18 (as drafted)
provenance: Drafted by Claude. Described questions use products with exactly one KEV entry, so there is one correct CVE.

questions.question: Our SonicWall SMA 100 SSL VPN appliance was hit by an unauthenticated SQL injection that exposed credentials. Is this a known exploited bug?
TeamViewer installs share one encryption key across customers, letting attackers bypass remote-login controls. Which KEV entry is that?
A regular domain user was able to make themselves a domain admin through a flaw in the Kerberos KDC. What vulnerability is this?
Attackers pointed our FortiGate's LDAP settings at their own server to steal the LDAP bind credentials. Known exploited?
Users opened attachments without the Outlook security warning appearing, because of a bypass bug. Which CVE?
Shell metacharacters sent to a Sunhillo SureLine device let attackers run commands on it.
Someone hijacked an admin session on our D-Link DIR-600 router with a forged request and changed its settings.
A crafted ping parameter on a D-Link DIR-820 router gave a remote attacker root.
The management interface of our Kemp LoadMaster load balancer was abused for unauthenticated command injection.
An Edimax IC-7100 IP camera was taken over with crafted requests that ran OS commands.
Attackers uploaded and ran PHP on our Joomla site by creating new editor profiles in JCE.
Attackers used ProFTPD's site copy commands to read and write files they shouldn't reach.
Puppet Enterprise report processing was abused through untrusted deserialization. Is this on the KEV list?
Our Check Point security gateways and management server were hit by a recently added exploited vulnerability. Which one?
